We Print
Friction.

Templates make everything feel the same. STATIC//NOISE exists to make things feel like something again — loud, awkward, specific, alive. Subscribe and we'll mail static straight to your screen four times a year.

The Operating Principles

  1. Legibility is negotiable; meaning is not.
  2. If the grid never breaks, you weren't pushing it.
  3. Texture over polish. Grain over gloss.
  4. Pay the contributors. Always.
STATIC//NOISE

An independent, reader-funded zine about art, design, sound and the texture of now. Made on a kitchen table and a borrowed Risograph.
